points.description: States that the best case is an already sorted array and that insertion sort then takes about N operations (linear, O(N), N = length of the array).
points.partial_credit: Award 2–3 marks if only one half is given correctly: either the sorted-array best case or N / linear operations, but not both.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the best case is a sorted array and the cost is N (or linear/O(N)), in any wording. Give part marks (about 2–3) if only the sorted-input condition or only the N count is correct. Give no marks if neither is stated, or if the answer says N² or a reverse-sorted array. Extra remarks do not cost marks unless they contradict the core fact.
